combinations.name: construction + raid interruption
combinations.coupling: Both a settlement's active construction commission and a raid's contact/compensation draw an exact water reservation from the SAME survey via KingdomWaterDebit.ReserveExactStore/ReserveExactWater: construction at Growth/KingdomCommission.cs:205 (ReserveExactWater) and Growth/KingdomConstruction.Funding.cs:68, raid contact at Raids/KingdomRaids.06.AttackResolutionAndOutbox.cs:107-108 (ReserveExactStore). KingdomWaterDebit.cs:156 is the shared reservation authority both lanes call into.
combinations.prerequisites: a founded settlement with an in-progress construction commission (Working phase, unfinished) AND a raid contact/attack resolved against the same zone within the same interval
combinations.invariants: conservation of water: sum of all outstanding reservations against the survey never exceeds the real store census; a raid's compensation debit and a construction job's funding debit against the same store never double-reserve the same drams; custody by reference (the construction job's own Water reservation object is never silently reused or mutated by the raid's debit path)
combinations.seed_turn_matrix: one fixed seed; 2 turn-order variants (raid resolves before vs after the construction job's daily funding poll in the same tick window); no further seed variation -- this is a two-cell matrix, not a sweep
combinations.expected_failure_rows: a torn/negative water census after both debits settle; a construction job stuck Funded with a Water reservation object no longer in Reserved state but no journaled cause
combinations.reusable_seams: Harness/KingdomTeardownNativeProvider.cs (commission half) + Harness/KingdomRaidContactNativeProvider.cs (contact half) -- no existing seam runs both together

combinations.name: multiple cities + travel + save/load
combinations.coupling: Travel's loaded-index scan is per-zone (Harness/KingdomCity.NativeTravelDemand.cs:38, walking Growth/KingdomSurvey's LoadedObjects), and a second founded city is a second, independent KingdomSystem/zone pair under the same save (Core/KingdomSystem.z01.State.Foundation.cs founding identity). The shared authority is the save's own system registry each city's founding claims a slot in -- no driver currently founds a second city at all (row 12, NONE), so this coupling is untested even at the single-behaviour level.
combinations.prerequisites: two founded settlements in the same save AND at least one travel (away/return) cycle for a resident of one of them, followed by a save/cold-load
combinations.invariants: city/actor isolation by reference: a travel scan against city A's zone never reads or credits city B's stockpile/roster; save/cold-load reproduces both cities' System identities and bindings distinctly (no merged or aliased KingdomSystem after reload)
combinations.seed_turn_matrix: one fixed seed; single scenario shape (found city A, found city B, travel one resident of A away and back, save, cold-load, re-assert both cities' rosters/stock unchanged) -- not a sweep, a single bounded chain
combinations.expected_failure_rows: a travel scan against A observing or crediting B's objects; a cold-load that merges the two cities' System records or loses one
combinations.reusable_seams: NONE -- no existing driver founds a second city, so this chain has no reachable starting seam at all

combinations.name: heart upgrade + replacement/teardown
combinations.coupling: The heart's own upgrade chain and an ordinary building's teardown/replacement chain both go through the SAME successor/removal-proof authority, r_KingdomScaffold: HasPendingImprovementSuccessorAuthority gates IsFunctionallyBuilt (Growth/KingdomUpgrade.09.RegistryAndIdentity.cs:165) exactly as HasRemovalProof/IsExactSuccessor gate ordinary handover removal (Growth/KingdomUpgrade.25.HandoverRemoval.cs:56,75,90-100).
combinations.prerequisites: a heart at rung 1-4 (gap, #141/#148) mid-upgrade AND an ordinary building on the same plot/lot queued for OrderStrike or a tier-replace in the same interval
combinations.invariants: only one successor authority claim exists per subject at a time (a heart upgrade in flight and an ordinary strike on the same lot never both hold r_KingdomScaffold successor state); a struck ordinary building's removal never clears or corrupts the heart's own pending-successor marker
combinations.seed_turn_matrix: one fixed seed; single ordering case (heart upgrade staged, then teardown ordered on an adjacent plot before the heart upgrade completes) -- no sweep
combinations.expected_failure_rows: a heart upgrade that silently completes or stalls because an unrelated teardown cleared a shared scaffold marker; a teardown that refuses because it misreads the heart's own pending marker as its own
combinations.reusable_seams: Harness/KingdomTeardownNativeProvider.cs (teardown half); NONE for the heart-upgrade half (rows 9/10 have no driver at all)

combinations.name: NPC join/leave + water/food shortage
combinations.coupling: Arrival (Growth/KingdomFirstGuestRuntime.cs, gated by Experience/KingdomGrowthFirstGuestRules.Choices.cs) and departure capacity (Growth/KingdomResidentDepartureRuntime.Capacity.cs, KingdomSystem.ResidentDepartureCapacityWarnings) both key off the settlement's water census read at Core/KingdomReportsPeople.cs:43 (KingdomGrowth.CountStoredWater), the same census Growth/KingdomCommission.cs:205 draws down for construction. NOTE: the exact conditional that denies/motivates arrival or departure from a shortage reading was not traced line-by-line this pass -- the coupling is the shared census, not a confirmed shared branch; treat prerequisites below as approximate.
combinations.prerequisites: a settlement at or below its water/food shortage threshold AND a pending first-guest candidate AND (row 4 has no driver) no way to independently force a departure attempt in the same window
combinations.invariants: conservation of water/food: an arrival's dedication and a departure's capacity bookkeeping never double-count or double-release the same stock; a shortage state is read consistently by both lanes in the same tick (no stale read on one side and fresh on the other)
combinations.seed_turn_matrix: one fixed seed; single scenario shape once row 4 gets a driver -- currently NOT REACHABLE at all because row 4 (resident departure) has no driver
combinations.expected_failure_rows: N/A -- unreachable until row 4 has a driver; recorded as backlog shape only
combinations.reusable_seams: NONE -- row 4 has no driver to build this chain on

combinations.name: stockpile/materials + construction (shared store conservation)
combinations.coupling: KingdomCommission.CanPay reads the exact same dedicated stockpile tally that OrderStrike later debits for salvage: both go through Growth/KingdomMaterials.05.StockpileAndPaymentGates.cs's stockpile registry, and Growth/KingdomCommission.cs:167 constructs its claim from KingdomMaterials.CostFor(entry.Key) against the same store the teardown fixture's OrderStrike (Growth/KingdomMaterials.08.StrikeOrdering.cs:23) draws salvage back into.
combinations.prerequisites: a dedicated stockpile funding one commission while a second, already-built commission on the same store is struck for salvage in the same interval
combinations.invariants: conservation of materials: the store's raw census after both the new commission's debit and the struck building's salvage credit equals the arithmetic sum of the two independently-computed deltas -- no interleaving artifact credits or loses units
combinations.seed_turn_matrix: one fixed seed; single interleaving case (commission B's funding debit lands in the same tick as building A's strike-salvage credit) -- no sweep
combinations.expected_failure_rows: a store census that differs from the two independently computed deltas summed; a commission that reads a stale pre-strike census and over/under-commits
combinations.reusable_seams: Harness/KingdomTeardownNativeProvider.cs already commissions+strikes one building on a dedicated store -- extending it with a second concurrent commission on the SAME store is the cheapest path to this chain

combinations.name: founding + multiple cities (registry isolation)
combinations.coupling: Founding claims a System/zone identity slot at Core/KingdomSystem.z05.Identity.Founding.cs and Core/KingdomSystem.z01.State.Foundation.cs; a second founding on the same save must claim a DISTINCT slot in the same registry rather than aliasing or overwriting the first. Row 12 (multiple cities) has no driver at all, so this shared-authority claim is currently untested even once.
combinations.prerequisites: one already-founded settlement AND a second founding attempt in the same save
combinations.invariants: city isolation by reference: the second founding's System is a distinct object from the first's; no shared mutable field (ledger, stockpile registry, roster) is aliased between the two
combinations.seed_turn_matrix: one fixed seed; single scenario (found city A, then found city B in the same save, assert both Systems distinct and both rosters/stocks independent) -- no sweep
combinations.expected_failure_rows: a second founding that silently reuses or mutates the first city's System instance; a shared ledger/stockpile reference between the two
combinations.reusable_seams: Harness/KingdomNativeCampFounding.Found (reusable helper) called twice in one fixture -- no existing driver does this
